name: std::mbsinit
intro: If ps is not a null pointer, the mbsinit function determines whether the pointed-to std::mbstate_t object describes the initial conversion state.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Although a zero-initialized std::mbstate_t always represents the initial conversion state, there may be other values of std::mbstate_t that also represent the initial conversion state.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ps

 -

 pointer to the std::mbstate_t object to examine

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: 0 if ps is not a null pointer and does not represent the initial conversion state, nonzero value otherwise.

examples.output:
After processing the first 1 byte of \u6c34 the conversion state is not initial
After processing the remaining 2 bytes of \u6c34, the conversion state is initial conversion state
